description: Find free browser games in the current SnackTurn catalog. Search with a game name or short keywords in English or Simplified Chinese. All query words must match. Filter by category or solo/multiplayer mode. Returns actual game descriptions, controls, player counts and links; use get_game_rules for full rules.

category.description: A category from the public game catalog.

language.description: Language of the returned content and links.

mode.description: Solo includes bot practice when the game offers it; multiplayer means playing with other people.

query.description: Game name or short keywords, such as "Bluff", "merge" or "螺丝". Omit to browse.

name: find_games
title: Find SnackTurn games
